description: This file defines the main application structure and behavior for a macOS app using SwiftUI. It includes the App struct, delegate, and related classes to manage the application lifecycle, menu bar item, settings, and update logic. It contains UI component setups, event handling, and app initialization routines.

classes.name: StatusItemMouseHandlerView
classes.description: A transparent overlay NSView that intercepts mouse events for the status bar item, handling clicks and hover events.

classes.name: AppDelegate
classes.description: NSApplicationDelegate managing app launch, termination, and related startup routines.

methods.name: applicationDidFinishLaunching
methods.description: Sets up the application, initializes state, and executes one-time startup routines.

methods.name: applicationWillTerminate
methods.description: Handles cleanup tasks when the app is terminating.

methods.name: scheduleFirstRunOnboardingIfNeeded
methods.description: Shows onboarding if the user has not seen it for current version.

methods.name: isDuplicateInstance
methods.description: Checks if another instance of the app is already running.

methods.name: application
methods.description: Handles custom URL schemes for deep linking.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Tracks whether an update is available (used by Sparkle updater).
